description: This PHP class defines the RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor, which handles processing registration event related to employee activation, including retrieving employee count data and determining if an event should be saved based on employee count changes.

classes.name: RegistrationEmployeeActivationEventProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing employee activation registration events, providing event type, gathering event data, and deciding whether to save the event based on employee count.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Returns the specific event type constant for employee activation events.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Gathers registration event data including current employee count filtered to only include current employees.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Determines whether a registration event should be saved based on employee count thresholds.
